description.en: Open-source React design system with 114+ accessible components matching Figma 1:1.
description.zh: 开源 React 设计系统：提供与 Figma 1:1 对齐的 114+ 无障碍组件与 41 套整页区块。

content.en: Sakani is an open-source React design system engineered to bridge design and code with zero redlines. It features over 114 accessible components built on semantic tokens and 41 production-ready layout blocks across dashboards, analytics, and settings. With full Figma token alignment, CSS variable theming, and built-in dark mode, it allows developers and designers to build consistent user interfaces rapidly.
content.zh: Sakani 是一套专为消除设计与研发割裂而打造的开源 React 设计系统。整套系统提供 114+ 款符合无障碍标准的原子级组件与 41 套开箱即用的仪表盘、数据分析与管理后台区块。基于语义化设计令牌（Tokens）与原生 CSS 变量驱动，提供与 Figma 规范 1:1 精确对应的暗黑模式支持与极简定制体验。
